title: GOLD case
description: One GOLD case, single-turn (query and expected) or multi-turn (turns). Its uid is a truncated SHA-256 of the case content: the query plus its non-empty expected values or, for a multi-turn case, every turn's query, expected values and, where the store's MANIFEST.json sets uid_includes_deltas (cases/v2), non-empty deltas, in order. Status, group and notes are never hashed. See src/goldset/canonical.py; tools/check.py fails if a stored uid does not match.

id.description: Stable lineage id (e.g. '1-030', 'mt-001'). Survives edits; identifies the test's intent across versions.

uid.description: Content hash of query/queries + expectations. In cases/v2 (MANIFEST.json uid_includes_deltas: true) it also covers each multi-turn turn's non-empty deltas, canonicalised so key and list order never matter; in cases/v1 (flag absent, frozen baseline) deltas do not participate. Changes on every semantic edit; results are keyed on it.

status.description: Lifecycle state, in lower case: ready (not yet verified at the current uid), todo (held by a known blocker), done (verified at the current uid) or not doing (parked, so gold run skips it). What each requires: cases/README.md, Status lifecycle.

group.description: Capability grouping (test_group); also the case's directory.

query.description: Single-turn only: the user prompt sent verbatim to the agent.

expected.description: Single-turn only: the values the case is graded on, each a string. Every non-empty value is part of the uid; most switch on one or more checks (see the index in src/goldset/evaluators/README.md). What ';' means differs by field: see cases/README.md.

turns.description: Multi-turn only: scripted turns sharing one thread. Turn text must never depend on the agent's previous free text (determinism rule).

deltas.description: Turn 2 onwards (ignored on turn 1): how the agent's state should move since the previous turn, scored as the state_delta check. changed: the field must differ from the previous turn. retain: it must stay the same (catches lost context). absent: it must be empty (catches carry-over). Field names are the per-turn state snapshot (SNAPSHOT_FIELDS in src/goldset/runner/multiturn.py). In cases/v2 deltas are part of the uid; in cases/v1 they are not.

notes.description: Non-scored annotations. Never hashed: triage commentary must not mint a new version.

fieldList.$comment: Must equal SNAPSHOT_FIELDS in src/goldset/runner/multiturn.py; tests/test_schema.py enforces the sync. A typo'd field must fail at authoring time, not silently abstain at runtime.
